$comment: §4.1 — the Intent a play emits (controller class) and the standing order the body executes. Canonical rules: schemas/README.md. Caps: reason ≤ 64 bytes; whole encoding well under MaxEmitBytes (4096).
title: intent

point.$comment: REQUIRED iff kind is navigate_to; forbidden for hold (schema rejection either way, §6.1). Map pixels, inside map bounds; the engine validates and may NORMALIZE it via nearestReachable at emit (§6.1), and the accepted canonical bytes carry the returned point.

micro.$comment: SET kind: sorted, deduplicated; omit when empty. Stencil's permission set minus the deleted pursuit flag (§3.3).

idle_aim_center_brads.$comment: omit when unset; the finisher stamps it if absent (§7.3)

clamp_to_endzone.$comment: omit when false; meaningful in ctf only, ignored elsewhere

reason.$comment: telemetry only; omit when empty; cap is BYTES of UTF-8

combat.$comment: omit when neutral (everything empty/false). On the standing order this is the FOLDED policy (§7.1); on a controller emission it is the play's own.
